chunks: We sent him to a hundred thousand or more.
ai.seo_question: Who is the prophet mentioned in Surah As-Saffat verse 147 and who did he address?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is widely understood to refer to Prophet Jonah (Yunus), peace be upon him, who was sent to the people of Nineveh, rather than Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The mention of 'one hundred thousand or more' underscores the magnitude of Jonah's mission and the subsequent divine mercy granted to that vast congregation upon their repentance. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the universality of prophetic messages and the efficacy of collective repentance.
